title: The whole check, in any project
situation: Record corrections, second cold read, 2026-10-13: 0162 restated the whole check through cratylus's own one check, a development notion, so the shipped practice leaned on cratylus's repository.
decision: The whole check runs every check of the change, every example's check, every contract and the project's own tests, without stopping at the first failure; each failing run is followed by one round that fixes everything it revealed, then one more run. In cratylus's own repository that is its one check (development).
consequences: Nothing in the workflow depends on how cratylus checks itself.
